summary: PolyPid Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 1, 2026, announcing that the European Medicines Agency validated its Marketing Authorization Application for D-PLEX, submitted September 14, 2026 under the Centralized Procedure on therapeutic innovation grounds; validation triggers formal CHMP review. The MAA rests on the pivotal Phase 3 SHIELD II trial, which met its primary and key secondary endpoints with a 60% relative risk reduction in surgical site infections versus standard of care (p=0.0013). The NDA is separately under FDA Priority Review with a November 28, 2026 PDUFA date. This is a routine regulatory milestone disclosure, not a special situation; watch EU approval timing and label scope.
